entry_thesis: Rocket Lab is the #2 WSB 2026 Index pick with 41+ daily Reddit mentions and retail narrative firmly behind the 'space economy' thesis. Stock has pulled back ~30% from its January ATH of $99 to ~$69 after a post-earnings dip (Feb 26 Q4 2025 report) on Neutron delay concern — but the core fundamentals are intact: record $1.85B backlog (+73% YoY), $816M SDA prime contract, and Q1 2026 guidance of $185-200M (57% growth). Sentiment registers the dip as a buy opportunity — retail is calling it a 'pullback on noise' while the government contract story accelerates; early March Fear & Greed reading of ~27-44 means retail sentiment still has room to rebuild as market digests the fundamentals.
risk: Neutron heavy-lift rocket delay to Q4 2026 after tank test failure could keep growth multiple compressed; broader market tariff/geopolitical risk-off environment could push high-multiple space stocks lower before the rebound.
catalyst: WSB retail re-accumulation post-earnings dip, $190M DoD HASTE contract narrative building, SpaceX IPO hype lifting all commercial space names, Q1 2026 earnings beat potential given strong backlog conversion (37% converts in 12 months)
